Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:10:1.english: [More] stringent than consecrated items - For one redeems it with money at its value.

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:10:2.english: To be stringent with him - That he may redeem it only with a lamb.

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:10:3.hebrew: אלא להקל עליו - דאם פודהו בשה, יכול לפדותו בפטרוזא:
Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:10:3.english: Rather, to be lenient with him - For if he redeems it with a lamb, he can redeem it with an emaciated [lamb].

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:12:1.hebrew: ממונא דבעלים הוא - ולא מצי כהן לזבוני להאי פודה, ופדיונו פדוי לבעלים, וזה הניח מעותיו על קרן הצבי:
Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:12:1.english: It is the property of the owner - And the priest cannot sell [it] to this redeemer, and its redemption takes effect for the owner, and this [redeemer] has placed his money on the horn of a deer [i.e., has lost his money].

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:13:1.hebrew: ונתן הכסף - דכתיב: "ואם המקדיש יגאל" וגו', משמע: כל מי שיתן הכסף, יהא ההקדש שלו:
Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:13:1.english: And he will give the money - For it is written: “And if the one who consecrated [it] will redeem...” etc., which implies that whoever gives the money, the consecrated property shall be his.

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:13:2.hebrew: או דלמא כיון דקני - האי פטר חמור לבעלים להאי דביני וביני, דיכול לפדותו בשה. אע"ג דכוליה לא קני ליה כל זמן שלא פדאו, אפ"ה ממונא דידיה הוא:
Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:13:2.english: Or perhaps since it acquires - This firstborn donkey [acquires] for the owner that [difference] between them, as he can redeem it with a lamb. Even though he does not acquire all of it as long as he has not redeemed it, nevertheless it is his property.

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:14:1.hebrew: ואע"פ שאין לו עכשיו - כלומר, שאע"פ שאין לו עכשיו רשות, יש לו לאחר זמן שיפדהו. הלכך, הוי כאילו הוא השתא דידיה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:14:1.english: And even though he does not have [it] now - That is to say, even though he does not currently have rights [over it], he will have [them] at a later time, when he redeems it. Therefore, it is considered as though it is his now.

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:16:1.hebrew: וגונב מבית האיש אמר רחמנא - ישלם שנים — לא מבית הקדש, דאין תשלומי כפל להקדש:
Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:16:1.english: “And it be stolen from the man’s house,” the Merciful One states - [Then] “he shall pay double” — [but] not from the house of consecrated property, for there is no double payment for consecrated property.

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:18:1.hebrew: אי אתה יכול לומר בבא ליד כהן - אם נתנו ישראל לכהן, שוב אינו נכנס להתעשר — לא ביד כהן ולא ביד ישראל, ואפילו חזר ישראל ולקחו הימנו או הכהן נתנו לו — שהרי שנינו כו':
Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:18:1.english: You cannot say [that it is referring to a case] where it entered the possession of a priest - If an Israelite gave it to a priest, it can no longer enter [the pen] to be tithed — neither in the possession of a priest nor in the possession of an Israelite, and even if the Israelite went back and purchased it from him or the priest gave it [back] to him — as we learned, etc.

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:18:2.hebrew: ספק פטרי חמורים - כגון שהיה לו עשר חמורות, וילדו כולן זכר ונקבה, שמפריש עליהן עשרה שיין לאפקועי לאיסורייהו, ומעשרן לשיין כשאר בהמות חולין, והן שלו. והמעשר קרב שלמים, והוא אוכלו כדין שאר מעשר בהמה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:18:2.english: Uncertain firstborns of donkeys - For example, where he had ten female donkeys, and they each gave birth to a male and a female, so that he designates ten lambs for them to remove their prohibition, and he tithes them — the lambs — like other unconsecrated animals, and they are his; and the tithe is sacrificed as a peace-offering, and he eats it in accordance with the law of any [other] animal tithe.

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:1:1.hebrew: בהשג יד כתיב - האומר "ערכי עלי", ואין לו כדי ערך — כתיב ביה (ויקרא כ״ז:ח׳): "על פי אשר תשיג יד הנודר יעריכנו הכהן", וכתיב בתריה: "וכל ערכך" וגו' — דאי נמי לית ליה שוה שקל, לא יעריכנו הכהן פחות משקל:
Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:1:1.english: It is written with regard to affordability - [In the case of] one who says, "My valuation is upon me," and he does not have enough [funds] for the valuation, it is written concerning him: (Leviticus 27:8) "According to the means of the one who vows shall the priest value him," and it is written after it: "And all your valuations, etc.," [teaching] that even if he does not have the value of a shekel, the priest shall not evaluate him at less than a shekel.

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:20:1.hebrew: ואותו אבי אמו כהן נפלו לו כו' - דאז חייבין בפדיון, דברשות ישראל נולדו:
Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:20:1.english: And that mother’s father, a priest, had [them] fall to him, etc. - For then they are obligated in redemption, as they were born in the possession of an Israelite.

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:21:1.english: Designates ten lambs for them - To remove their prohibition.

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:21:2.hebrew: והן שלו - דמאי דמיחייב כהן המורישו לעשות מהן, עושה זה מהן: דלכהן המוריש היה צריך להפריש עליהן שיין להפקיע קדושה שחלה עליהן בבית ישראל ראשון, ונוטל השיין לעצמו, שהרי כהן הוא ואין צריך לחזר אחר כהן — הכי נמי עושה ישראל זה היורשו, דדמי כמי שהורישו כהן השיין:
Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:21:2.english: And they are his - For whatever the priest who bequeathed [them] to him was obligated to do with them, this [heir] does with them: For the priest who bequeathed [them] was required to designate lambs for them to remove the sanctity that took effect upon them in the house of the first Israelite, and he would take the lambs for himself, since he is a priest and does not need to seek out [another] priest; so too does this Israelite who inherits from him do, as it is considered as if the priest bequeathed him the lambs.

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:22:1.hebrew: ממורחין - שנגמרה מלאכתן למעשר, דמירוח גמר מלאכה של תבואה, כשמשוה את הכרי ומחליקו ברחת:
Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:22:1.english: Smoothed - That their processing for tithing was completed, for smoothing is the completion of the processing of grain, when one levels the heap and smooths it with a winnowing shovel.

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:22:2.hebrew: ואותו אבי אמו כהן כו' - רבותא קמ"ל, דאע"ג דמכח ישראל קאתי, דאיכא למימר ניתבינהו השתא לתרומה (ומעשר) לכהן כי היכי דהוה עביד ישראל קמא — אפי' הכי, כיון דיד כהן באמצע, הוי כאילו הפריש הכהן האמצעי מהן התרומה והוריש לישראל זה כל אחד בפני עצמו, ומעשרן והכל שלו, ומוכר התרומה לכהנים. והוא הדין נמי אם לא נפלו לאותו כהן מישראל — דתבואת כהן חייבת בתרומה, אלא שאינה נותנה לכהן אחר, אלא מפרישה ואוכלה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:22:2.english: And that mother’s father [who was] a priest, etc. - [This] comes to teach us a novelty: that even though [the produce] comes through an Israelite, where one might say [that] he should give them now as teruma (and tithes) to a priest, just as the first Israelite would have done — even so, since the hand of a priest was in the middle, it is as though the intermediate priest separated the teruma from them and bequeathed each one on its own to this Israelite; and he tithes them, and everything is his, and he sells the teruma to priests. And the same ruling applies as well if [the produce] had not fallen to that priest from an Israelite — for the produce of a priest is obligated in teruma, except that he does not give it to another priest, but rather separates it and eats it.

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:23:1.hebrew: משום דהוה מופרש וקאי - כלומר, שהשה מין אחד וחמור מין אחר, ואינו מחוסר מעשה. הלכך, הוי כאילו נפלו לו מבית כהן החמורים לעצמן והטלאים לעצמן:
Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:23:1.english: Because it stands separated - That is to say, the lamb is one species and the donkey is another species, and it does not lack an action [of separation]. Therefore, it is as if the donkeys on their own and the lambs on their own fell to him [as an inheritance] from the house of the priest.

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:24:1.hebrew: אבל - גבי תבואה, דמחוסר הפרשה, אימא: כמי שלא הורמו בבית כהן דמיין, וחזרו לאיסורם הראשון, ויתנם לכהן:
Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:24:1.english: But - In the case of grain, which lacks separation, say: They are treated as if they were not separated in the house of a priest, and they reverted to their original forbidden status, and he must give them to a priest.

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:2:1.english: The halakha is in accordance with the words of the Sages - That its redemption is with any lamb whatsoever.

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:2:3.hebrew: בר דנקא - קטן שאינו שוה אלא מעה, שהוא שתות דינר:
Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:2:3.english: Worth a danka - A small [lamb] that is worth only a ma’ah, which is a sixth of a dinar.

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:2:4.english: We also learn - In the Mishnah:

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:3:1.hebrew: פשיטא - דאפילו פטרוזא, דהא כל שהוא קאמרי רבנן לעיל:
Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:3:1.english: [Isn’t it] obvious - That [one may use] even a lean lamb [patruza], for the Rabbis said above: "[A lamb of] any amount."

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:3:2.hebrew: כולי האי - בר דנקא. אי נמי: נהי דקטן יכול ליתן, אבל פטרוזא, שהוא כחוש — לא:
Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:3:2.english: Such [little value] - Worth a danka. Alternatively: granted that one may give a small [lamb], but a patruza, which is emaciated, [one may] not [give].

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:5:1.english: Accustomed here and accustomed there - [It is] less than a sela and more than a shekel.

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:6:1.hebrew: קשיא הלכתא אהלכתא - הכא אמרת הלכתא ברגיא, ולעיל אמרת הלכתא כדברי חכמים, דאפי' בר דנקא:
Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:6:1.english: One halakha contradicts another halakha - Here you said that the halakha is [to redeem] with a ragya, and above you said that the halakha is in accordance with the statement of the Sages, that even [a lamb] worth a danka [is valid].

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:6:2.hebrew: בא לימלך - מה יתן לכהן, אמרינן ליה: ברגיא:
Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:6:2.english: [One who] comes to consult - [as to] what he should give to the priest, we say to him: [A lamb worth] a ragya.

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:6:3.hebrew: בעושה מעצמו - ונותן בר דנקא, לא כייפינן ליה טפי:
Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:6:3.english: In [the case of] one who acts on his own - And gives [a lamb] worth a danka, we do not compel him [to give] more.

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:7:1.hebrew: האמר - בשמעתין לעיל (בכורות דף ט:): "הקפידה תורה עליו בשה". ואע"ג דתרצינן לעיל: "בשויו לא קאמרינן", מיהו האי מקשה, מאי דסלקא דעתך מעיקרא נקט:
Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:7:1.english: Doesn't he say - In our discussion above (Bekhorot 9b): "The Torah was particular about it [being redeemed] with a lamb." And even though we answered above, "We did not say [this applies] at its [full] value," nevertheless, this questioner adopted what had initially entered [our] mind.

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:8:1.hebrew: רבינא קשיא ליה - אמאי מוקמת למימרא דריש לקיש כרבי שמעון? הא קיימא לן דרבי יהודה ורבי שמעון הלכה כרבי יהודה — בעירובין בפרק מי שהוציאוהו (עירובין דף מו:) — וסתם לן תנא דמתניתין כרבי יהודה, דאסר לפטר חמור בהנאה, דקתני: מפריש טלה לאפקועיה לאיסוריה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:8:1.english: Ravina found this difficult - Why do you establish the statement of Reish Lakish in accordance with Rabbi Shimon? Behold, it is established for us that [in a dispute between] Rabbi Yehuda and Rabbi Shimon, the halakha is in accordance with Rabbi Yehuda — in Eruvin, in the chapter [entitled] "Mi Shehotzi’uhu" (Eruvin 46b) — and the tanna of our Mishnah taught an unattributed [ruling] in accordance with Rabbi Yehuda, who prohibits [deriving] benefit from a firstborn donkey, as it teaches: He designates a lamb to abrogate its forbidden status.

Rashi on Bekhorot 11a:9:1.english: And you say - [You state] your statement in accordance with Rabbi Shimon.

Tosafot on Bekhorot 11a:11:1.hebrew: הפודה פטר חמור של חבירו פדיונו פדוי - לא דמי לתורם משלו על חבירו, דאיבעיא לן פרק אין בין המודר (נדרים דף לו:) אם צריך דעת; דהתם כתיב: "גם אתם" לרבות שלוחכם, ובעינן: מה אתם לדעתכם, אף שלוחכם לדעתכם; אבל הכא, לא כתיב בעלים:
Tosafot on Bekhorot 11a:11:1.english: One who redeems the firstborn donkey of another, his redemption is valid - [This] is not similar to one who separates terumah from his own [produce] on behalf of [the produce of] another, where it was raised as a dilemma for us in the chapter [entitled] Ein Bein HaMuddar (Nedarim 36b) whether he requires [the owner's] consent. For there it is written: “You also” — to include your agent, and we require: Just as you [act] with your consent, so too your agent [must act] with your consent; but here, “owner” is not written.

Tosafot on Bekhorot 11a:16:1.hebrew: וגונב מבית האיש ולא מבית הקדש - פרק מרובה (ב"ק דף סב:) איתא הך דרשא, דקאמר: "מרעהו ולא מהקדש" נפקא. ופירש: "איש" לא מיותר, דגזבר נמי מקרי איש, ולא משתמע כלל מ"איש" למעוטי — דבכל דבר שהוא לשון זכר שייך לשון "איש", ואשה על נקבה, כמו (שמות כ״ו:ג׳) "אשה אל אחותה". והא דאמרינן הכא "מבית האיש ולא מבית הקדש" — כדנפקא מ"רעהו"; ומשום דהא קרא "וגונב" מיירי בתשלומין מייתי לה:
Tosafot on Bekhorot 11a:16:1.english: “And it be stolen from the man’s house” — but not from the house of consecrated property - In [the chapter entitled] Merubah (Bava Kamma 62b), this exposition is found, where it states: it is derived [instead] from “his neighbor” (Exodus 22:8) — “and not consecrated property.” And [it is] explained: [The word] “man” is not superfluous, because the [Temple] treasurer is also called a “man,” and it is not implied at all from “man” to exclude [consecrated property] — for to anything that is grammatically masculine the term “man” applies, and “woman” to feminine, as in (Exodus 26:3): “A woman to her sister.” And as for that which we say here, “from the man’s house — but not from the house of consecrated property,” [this is really] as it is derived from “his neighbor”; and [it is only] because this verse, “and it be stolen,” deals with [the thief’s double] payments that it cites it.

Tosafot on Bekhorot 11a:18:1.hebrew: שהיו לו עשרה ספק [פטרי] חמורים מפריש עשרה שיין ומעשרן והן שלו - לפר"ת, דמפרש לעיל "פודה וחוזר אפילו פעמים הרבה" אספיקות קאי — קשה: למה לי עשרה שיין? בשה אחד סגי! אבל לפירוש הקונטרס, דאינו חוזר ופודה אלא אם כן נתנו לכהן וחוזר ולקחן — ניחא. ומיהו לפירושו נמי קשה: ההיא דלקמן, "ישראל שהיו לו י' פטרי חמורין ודאין בתוך ביתו, שנפלו לו מבית אבי אמו כהן, ואותו אבי אמו כהן נפלו לו מבית אבי אמו ישראל, מפריש עליהן עשרה שיין והן שלו" — התם למה לי עשרה? בחד סגי, שמן הדין הן שלו אע"פ שהן ודאין; אם כן, בכל פעם ופעם חשוב כאילו נתנו לכהן וחזר ולקחן, דמכח אבי אמו כהן הוא יורש! ונראה, דבכל הני דנקט עשר' לרבותא: אע"ג שכולן פטר חמור, כולן נכנסין לדיר להתעשר:
Tosafot on Bekhorot 11a:18:1.english: "Who had ten uncertain [firstborn] donkeys, designates ten lambs for them, and tithes them, and they are his" - According to the explanation of Rabbeinu Tam, who explains above that [the statement that] one may redeem [a donkey with a lamb] repeatedly refers to [cases of] uncertainties, it is difficult: Why do I need ten lambs? One lamb should suffice! However, according to the interpretation of Rashi, that one cannot go back and redeem [with the same lamb] unless he gave it to a priest and then reacquired it from him, it is understandable. Yet according to his interpretation as well, that which is taught below is difficult: "An Israelite who had ten definite firstborn donkeys in his house, which fell to him [as an inheritance] from the estate of his mother's father, who was a priest, and [as for] that mother's father, the priest, they had fallen to him from the estate of his mother's father, who was an Israelite — he designates ten lambs for them and they are his." There, why do I need ten? One should suffice, for by law they belong to him even though they are definite [firstborn donkeys]; if so, in each and every instance it should be considered as if he gave it to a priest and reacquired it, since he inherits [the priest's rights] by virtue of his mother's father, who was a priest! And it appears that in all of these [cases], the reason it mentioned ten is to teach a novelty: even though they are all [lambs designated for] firstborn donkeys, they all enter the corral to be tithed.

Tosafot on Bekhorot 11a:2:1.hebrew: אמר רבא אף אנן נמי תנינא גדול וקטן - יש ספרים דגרסי "תנינא", וקושיא היא זו:
Tosafot on Bekhorot 11a:2:1.english: "Rava says: We learn as well: A big and a small" - There are texts that read "Tenina" [We have learned], and this is an objection.

Tosafot on Bekhorot 11a:5:1.hebrew: והלכתא ברגיא - בבא לימלך מוקמי ליה, שמורים לפדותו בשה שוה שלשה זוזים, רגיל הכא; אבל בעצמו — אפילו בפטרוזא בת דנקא. ואם אין לו שה לפדותו — פודה בשויו, ואפי' בשלקי. וכד פריק ליה — מברך "על פדיון פטר חמור", ולא בשעת נתינה לכהן, דמעידנא דאפרשיה ברשותיה דכהן קאי, כדאמר לקמן בשמעתין(:). ושה — בין מכבשים בין מעזים, בין זכר בין נקבה, בין גדול בין קטן, כדתנן במתניתין:
Tosafot on Bekhorot 11a:5:1.english: "And the halakha is with a ragya" - We establish it [as referring to a case] where one comes to consult, [in which case] they instruct him to redeem it with a lamb worth three zuz, [which is] intermediate between this [sum] and that [sum] [i.e., close to this amount and close to that amount, between a sela and a shekel]; but on his own, [he fulfills his obligation] even with a lean lamb worth a danka. And if he does not have a lamb with which to redeem it, he redeems it at its value, and even with boiled vegetables. And when he redeems it, he recites the blessing: "concerning the redemption of a firstborn donkey", and not at the time of giving [it] to the priest, because from the time he designates it, it stands in the domain of the priest, as [the Gemara] says later in our sugya. And "a lamb" [may be] whether from sheep or from goats, whether male or female, whether large or small, as we learned in our Mishnah.
